According to known data, Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight? Wait Shenzhou 8 was a manned test flight? Actually Shenzhou 8 was a test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, but it was unmanned? Let me check memory: Shenzhou 8 launched on 25 September 2008, it was an unmanned test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft's docking system. It was a test of the docking mechanism with the Tiangong 1 space station. So there were no astronauts aboard Shenzhou 8. So answer: There were no astronauts; it was unmanned.
